manifest.name: Subsonic
manifest.author: Parachord Team
manifest.description: Stream music from your self-hosted Subsonic-compatible server (Navidrome, Subsonic, Airsonic, Gonic, ...). Configure the server URL, username and password in settings.

serverUrl.label: Server URL
serverUrl.description: Base URL of your Subsonic-compatible server. A trailing /rest is tolerated (e.g. http://192.168.0.13:4533 or http://navidrome.local:4533/rest).

password.label: Password
password.description: Your Subsonic account password. Sent as an MD5 token (salt + hash), never in plain text.
